look_here_first: Look for a sprawling or twining vine with thickened storage roots and highly variable heart-shaped to deeply lobed leaves. Flowers, when present, are pale pink to lavender morning-glory funnels with a darker throat.

lookalikes.differences: Compared with I. cordatotriloba, sweet potato is usually more robust and associated with cultivation, often with conspicuous storage roots and more variable, sometimes deeply lobed foliage. Do not treat escaped plants as Texas-native.
